## Synopsys Surges 11.2% After Raising Guidance on AI EDA Demand and Ansys Integration Progress

SNPS's 11.2% guidance-driven move validates that AI chip design complexity is translating into durable EDA revenue growth, while Ansys integration progress reduces the M&A execution risk that had been a persistent valuation discount.

- Synopsys raised guidance and the stock moved approximately 11.2%, as stated explicitly in the headline
- The dual drivers are accelerating AI EDA demand and tangible progress on integrating the Ansys acquisition
- The combination of organic AI cycle strength and M&A execution removes two distinct investor overhangs simultaneously
- Single-outlet; no specific revenue or EPS guidance figures are provided in the headline beyond the move and its stated catalysts
